Exhibit B: The Term Sheet

THE $150,000,000 LIE

Omni-Global claimed this was an "All-Cash" offer. Holly read the fine print and realized they were buying her company with her own money.

The Scene
  • Date: Sept 12, 2018 (10:00 AM)
  • Location: Conf. Room A, 40th Floor
  • Atmosphere: Vacuum Sealed

Jameson Frost is pacing. He's checked his Rolex three times in the last minute. He has the "Closing Champagne" on ice in the corner. He expects gratitude.

On the other side of the mahogany table, the O'Connell family is motionless. Cassidy offers a polite, frozen smile. Ryan stares at the wall. They aren't looking at the view. They aren't looking at the champagne.

Holly is reading. Every single line.

"He stood there leaning on the table, treating us like we were a garage band applying for a loan. He didn't realize that Holly wasn't looking for the signature line. She was looking for the trap."

Ryan O'Connell

Omni-Global Media

Mergers & Acquisitions Division
Date: Sept 12, 2018
Ref: ACQ-ERR-2018
Binding Letter of Intent
$150,000,000.00
All-Cash Transaction
1. Purchase Price & Payment

Omni-Global Media ("Buyer") agrees to purchase 100% of the equity of Engine Room Records, LLC ("Target") for a total consideration of One Hundred Fifty Million Dollars ($150,000,000.00), payable in full via wire transfer at Closing.

2. Asset Transfer

Includes all master recordings (The "Sun-Ray Catalog"), physical inventory, real estate holdings in Blacksburg, VA, and all intellectual property rights associated with the artist "The Stardust Engine."

Standard Covenants & Financing Contingencies
9.A. Buyer reserves the right to conduct final audit 48 hours prior to closing.

9.B. Target agrees to suspend all dividend distributions effective immediately upon signing.
9.C. Financing Contingency:
Funding of the Purchase Price is contingent upon Buyer securing a Senior Secured Credit Facility. Buyer shall grant a first-priority security interest in all post-closing assets of the Target (including but not limited to Copyrights and Royalties) as collateral to secure said facility.
Wait. Clause 9.C is an LBO.
They have no cash. They are borrowing against my assets to pay me.
The Smoking Gun Back

The Stardust Engine (ERR-001)

Named after the very first song Ryan, Cassidy, Evan, and Tyler wrote together at CPI in 1986—celebrating their shared love of the cosmos (“Stardust”) and the rockets to get you there (“Engine”).
